## Module Overview

### Module summary

`LandRCBM_fireRisk` combines a per-pixel burn probability with a per-pixel fire
susceptibility (the carbon that would be emitted to the atmosphere if a pixel
burned, from `LandRCBM`'s cohort and carbon-transfer tables) into a fire risk
raster.

This module does **not** estimate burn probability itself. Earlier versions ran
their own Monte Carlo ignition/escape/spread simulation internally; that logic
has moved out to two dedicated modules, `fireSense_burnProbability` and
`scfm_burnProbability`, which each estimate per-pixel burn probability by Monte
Carlo from their respective fire models (fireSense or scfm) and write it to
`sim$fireSense_BurnProbability` / `sim$scfm_BurnProbability`. `LandRCBM_fireRisk`
simply reads whichever of the two is supplied.

The `fireModel` parameter controls which one it reads:

- `"fireSense"`: requires `sim$fireSense_BurnProbability` (from
  `fireSense_burnProbability`).
- `"scfm"`: requires `sim$scfm_BurnProbability` (from `scfm_burnProbability`).
- `NA` (default): auto-detects -- uses whichever of the two inputs is supplied.
  It is an error if both are supplied (ambiguous) or if neither is (nothing to
  read).

`sim$fireProbability` is set to that raster unchanged; `sim$fireRisk` is then
`fireProbability * fireSusceptibility`.

Describe input data required by the module and how to obtain it (e.g., directly from online sources or supplied by other modules)
If `sourceURL` is specified, `downloadData("LandRCBM_fireRisk", "C:/Users/docaron/Documents/repos")` may be sufficient.

Run `fireSense_burnProbability` or `scfm_burnProbability` (or both, if you intend
to switch `fireModel` between runs) before `LandRCBM_fireRisk` so that
`sim$fireSense_BurnProbability` or `sim$scfm_BurnProbability` is available when
`calculateFireRisk` runs.

### Events

- `init`: schedules the first `calculateFireRisk` at `start(sim)`, and the first
  `plot` and `save` events.
- `calculateFireRisk`: sets `sim$fireProbability` from whichever
  `*_burnProbability` module supplied it (see `fireModel` above), computes
  `sim$fireSusceptibility` from `sim$cbm_vars` and `sim$cTransfers`, and sets
  `sim$fireRisk <- fireProbability * fireSusceptibility`. Reschedules itself
  annually until `end(sim)`.
- `plot`, `save`: template events; see source for current behaviour.

### Module outputs

Description of the module outputs (Table \@ref(tab:moduleOutputs-LandRCBM-fireRisk)).
`fireProbability` is passed through unchanged from `sim$fireSense_BurnProbability`
or `sim$scfm_BurnProbability`; see those modules' manuals for how to interpret it
(in particular, it is a per-year Monte Carlo estimate, not an exact probability,
and does not capture spatial dependence between pixels).

```{r moduleOutputs-LandRCBM-fireRisk, echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
df_outputs <- SpaDES.core::moduleOutputs("LandRCBM_fireRisk", "C:/Users/docaron/Documents/repos")
knitr::kable(df_outputs, caption = "List of (ref:LandRCBM-fireRisk) outputs and their description.") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "scale_down", full_width = TRUE)
```

### Links to other modules

- `fireSense_burnProbability` or `scfm_burnProbability` (exactly one, per
  `fireModel`) must run before `LandRCBM_fireRisk`, supplying
  `fireSense_BurnProbability` or `scfm_BurnProbability`.
- `LandRCBM`/`CBM_core` modules supply `cbm_vars` and `cTransfers`, used to
  compute `fireSusceptibility`.
